sources.title: A Little Knowledge Goes a Long Way: Faster Detection of Compromised Data in 2-D Tables
sources.venue: 1990 IEEE Computer Society Symposium on Research in Security and Privacy
sources.inspection: Scanned author PDF; first three PDF pages inspected visually. Plain text extraction did not recover usable text.
sources.supports: Tight uncertainty bounds for suppressed nonnegative table cells from marginal information through network flow, with reuse across cells.
sources.does_not_establish: Identity with the full nested-record, prospective uncertainty and shared-erasure formulation in this package.

sources.title: Designing and Expanding Electrical Networks - Complexity and Combinatorial Algorithms
sources.venue: Doctoral dissertation, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology
sources.inspection: Section 3.6, Proposition 3.16 and proof, printed pages 35-36 inspected in the full dissertation.
sources.supports: Budget-indexed series/parallel flow expansion recurrences: maximize over budget splits, take a minimum for series composition and a sum for parallel composition.
sources.implication: The fixed-target recurrence is a specialization of established dynamic programming. Truncating the budget to r already gives a corresponding limited-budget calculation; the nominal complexity cannot alone establish a new algorithm.
sources.does_not_establish: Priority for the complete statistical record interpretation and all-leaf statement; no assertion that this difference is sufficient for publication.

sources.authors: I. Demgensky; H. Noltemeier; H.-C. Wirth
sources.title: Optimizing cost flows by edge cost and capacity upgrade
sources.inspection: Publisher-origin text retrieved through the web tool, including abstract, introduction and capacity-upgrade discussion. Direct page opening was restricted. No local full-text copy retained.
sources.supports: Budgeted network-capacity upgrade and relevant structured-network treatments predate this report.
sources.does_not_establish: An identical complete theorem, or any speed comparison with this paper.

sources.title: The Complexity of Flow Expansion and Electrical Flow Expansion
sources.venue: SOFSEM 2021: Theory and Practice of Computer Science. Lecture Notes in Computer Science 12607
sources.inspection: Author accepted manuscript, Section 2 definitions and Section 5 Lemma 9. The detailed recurrence was checked in Wolf 2023, Proposition 3.16.
sources.supports: Earlier series-parallel single-source, single-sink expansion result. Capacities are integral in the source statement; simple graphs can represent parallel paths.
sources.derived_comparison: Proposition 5 of the TEM-FLOW research report constructs one record stage and unit-cost bypass per relevant measurement. For rational capacities this gives an exact scaled instance of the earlier expansion setting.
sources.does_not_establish: First-in-literature priority or the significance of the complete record-based structural characterization.

assessment.proved_in_this_package: Sharp cut characterization under stated assumptions; budget profiles; all-leaf computational bound; exact-record path threshold.
assessment.established_prior_ingredients: Max-flow/min-cut, flow-based uncertainty bounds, budgeted series/parallel recurrences and tree message reuse.
assessment.unresolved: Literature priority and substantial novelty of the complete specialization.
prohibited_claims: Existing methods cannot recover the same bounds under equivalent assumptions
Benchmark superiority over the fastest published method
assessment.corrected_novelty_standard: Equivalent numerical answers or an alternative solution do not disqualify a distinct theorem. Assess the precise relationship proved and whether it is already an equivalent theorem or a routine consequence.
assessment.explicit_overlap: One-target worst record-loss ambiguity is exactly representable as budgeted series-parallel expansion; the core recurrence is inherited. All-target compact reuse employs standard tree techniques.
assessment.defensible_framing: An alternative structural characterization of evidence sufficiency and fragility for nested aggregate mass records, with sharpness, all-target profiles, an exact threshold and an assumption-boundary counterexample.
assessment.priority_status: Not certified. The absence of an identical statement in the bounded comparison is not proof of originality.
